dict.string: This app needs access to your calendar to help you set loan repayment reminders.
Camera access is needed to take pictures of your identification documents and perform facial recognition. This process enhances the security and verification of your identity.
We would like to access your contacts to allow you to select emergency contacts for improving safety and assistance in case of urgent situations.
Your GPS location will be used to enhance fraud detection measures, specifically for fraud detection during the application process, and to show you nearby products.

This app needs access to the motion sensor to detect device shakes for certain security verification features.
We would like to access your photo library to enable you to select your ID photos. This is essential for proper identity verification and securing your account.
We need to use your device identifier for data analysis and risk control to improve the security of our app.
